name: Yumemiru Briar Rose ~Akuma wa Sasayaku dake~
original_name: 夢見るブライアローズ ～悪魔は囁くだけ～
source:
One day, you find yourself a victim of a traffic accident.
However, demon magic allows you to narrowly escape death.
When you wake up, you're in a mansion with a group of men claiming to be demons.

It seems you won't be able to return to your world for the next two weeks.

These two weeks will be filled with advances from demon men, as they whisper sweet nothings to you.
What will you do after the time is up...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17040]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某天，你遭遇了一场车祸。
然而，恶魔的魔法让你侥幸逃过一死。
醒来后，你发现自己身处一座宅邸，周围是一群自称恶魔的男子。

看来，接下来的两周里，你都无法回到自己的世界。

这两周中，恶魔男子们会不断向你示爱，在耳边诉说甜言蜜语。
期限到来后，你会作何选择……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17040]Freem![/url]]
